children: The Czech central bank could tighten monetary policy further but timing is not clear, and market pricing of four hikes over the next year looks excessive, board member Jan Kubicek told news website www.novinky.cz in an interview published on Thursday.
Kubicek told Reuters in July that one more tightening was possible this year.
